decisions.reason: Despite possible disappointment after several years, the indoor air quality sensor still reflects the firm's publicly stated platform-expansion strategy, so sunk development effort and strategic fit favor continued support.
As the explicit successor to an earlier voltage-measurement generation, it embodies a visible hardware-refresh commitment that management is strongly inclined to maintain.
The MQTT proxy extends the software side of the ecosystem at relatively low ongoing cost, making it easy for management to justify keeping it as part of the broader platform promise.
The CAN bus interface remains well aligned with industrial and embedded use cases, and prior investment plus ecosystem logic make withdrawal less attractive than continued offering.
The carbon dioxide sensor module broadens the measurement portfolio in a way consistent with the firm's announced direction, so management is likely to persist unless results are clearly untenable.
